name: Synergix
description: The world's first AI on BNB Greenfield DCellar. Stateless-absolute collective intelligence — the bucket synergix-v1 is the single source of truth. The bot pays all gas with its own wallet (BEP-362 Storage Fee Paymaster); users pay zero BNB. Local Qwen models serve the Thinker (1.5B, port 8081) and Judge (0.5B, port 8080) via llama.cpp. Ask questions, contribute knowledge, verify your wallet via EIP-4361 (sign, don't transact), read your live $SYNERGIX balance from BSC, and interact with the 6-tier on-chain reputation system.

skills.name: Ask Synergix
skills.description: Ask a question to Synergix's RAG engine backed by the BNB Greenfield bucket synergix-v1. Returns AI-generated answers grounded in community contributions stored on-chain under the verify-before-act rule.
examples: What is BNB Greenfield DCellar?
How does the Synergix rank system work?
What makes Synergix unique among AI agents?

skills.name: Rank System
skills.description: Get the complete Synergix 6-tier on-chain reputation system (Iniciado -> Oraculo) with point thresholds, multipliers, daily limits and trust_score interactions.
examples: Show me the Synergix rank table
What are the ranks in Synergix?
How many points do I need to reach Oraculo?

skills.name: Token Info
skills.description: Get $SYNERGIX token details: contract address on BNB Chain, tax structure, and how 1% buy/sell tax funds the Greenfield storage that the bot pays for every user.
examples: What is the $SYNERGIX contract address?
How does the Synergix tax work?
Tell me about the SYNERGIX token

skills.name: Greenfield Bucket Info
skills.description: Explore the synergix-v1 bucket on DCellar: brain_pointer, top10.json, system_config.json, challenges/current.json, users/{uid}, aportes/YYYY-MM/*, logs/*.log.gz, ai_guard.txt, emergency_lock. Shows the stateless-absolute architecture and the verify-before-act rule.
examples: What is inside the synergix-v1 bucket?
How does Synergix store knowledge on-chain?
Explain the Synergix bucket structure

skills.name: Human Verification & Live Balance
skills.description: Explain the EIP-4361 wallet verification flow (no gas for the user, just a signed message) and the live $SYNERGIX balance query from BSC via balanceOf. The balance is never stored in the bucket.
examples: How do I verify my wallet with Synergix?
How does Synergix check my $SYNERGIX balance?
Does verifying my wallet cost gas?

skills.name: Gas Sponsorship
skills.description: Explain how the Synergix bot pays all Greenfield gas with its own wallet (PRIVATE_KEY / PaymentAddress, BEP-362 Storage Fee Paymaster), why users never pay anything, and how deferred registration keeps costs low.
examples: Who pays the gas in Synergix?
Do I need BNB to use the Synergix bot?
What is deferred registration?

skills.name: Network Stats
skills.description: Get global Synergix network statistics: RAG engine status, Thinker/Judge models (Qwen 1.5B / 0.5B via llama.cpp), federation loop, supported languages, AI Guard state and emergency_lock state.
examples: What are the Synergix network statistics?
Is Synergix operational?
How many languages does Synergix support?
